title: Checks for usage of a character position yielded by .chars().enumerate() in a context where a byte index is expected, such as an argument to a specific str method or indexing into a str or String.
summary: A character (more specifically, a Unicode scalar value) that is yielded by str::chars can take up multiple bytes, so a character position does not necessarily have the same byte index at which the character is stored. Thus, using the character position where a byte index is expected can unexpectedly return wrong values or panic when the string consists of multibyte characters. Clippy puts this lint in the correctness group, at the level deny.

title: Checks for expressions where a character literal is cast to u8 and suggests using a byte literal instead.
summary: In general, casting values to smaller types is error-prone and should be avoided where possible. In the particular case of converting a character literal to u8, it is easy to avoid by just using a byte literal instead. As an added bonus, b'a' is also slightly shorter than 'a' as u8. Clippy puts this lint in the complexity group, at the level warn.

title: Checks for usage of _.chars().last() or _.chars().next_back() on a str to check if it ends with a given char.
summary: Readability, this can be written more concisely as _.ends_with(_). Clippy puts this lint in the style group, at the level warn.

title: Checks for usage of .chars().next() on a str to check if it starts with a given char.
summary: Readability, this can be written more concisely as _.starts_with(_). Clippy puts this lint in the style group, at the level warn.

title: Checks for explicit bounds checking when casting.
summary: Reduces the readability of statements & is error prone. Clippy puts this lint in the pedantic group, at the level allow.

title: Checks for usage of chunks_exact or chunks_exact_mut with a constant chunk size.
summary: as_chunks provides better ergonomics and type safety by returning arrays instead of slices. It was stabilized in Rust 1.88. Clippy puts this lint in the style group, at the level warn.
